Requirements You are currently harmonized.

Frequency Once per hour.

As two souls sharing the same body, you have learned that there are times when diverging goals for survival can lead to favorable outcomes. When you take this action, choose two different activities you can accomplish with up to three actions, such as a Strike or casting an anima spell. You attempt to perform both activities at the same time, but you do not resolve their outcomes, thus triggering any reactions from you trying to take those actions, and you make any rolls necessary for each action (but not if the target needs to roll, such as if you need them to make a saving throw). If both chosen activities require you to roll a d20 die, you only roll the die once.

After making any rolls or resolving any triggered reactions, you choose which action to commit to and resolve the outcomes, foregoing the outcomes of the other choice. At the end of Duality, you are no longer harmonized.
